troubleshooting_summary: Symptom: client JSON.parse errors due to incomplete or interleaved JSON while consuming streaming response.
Likely causes to investigate: streaming chunk boundary splitting JSON tokens; model occasionally emits fallback plain-text (no function call); schema mismatch on function 'arguments' shape.

Immediate mitigations suggested: enable 'json_mode' / structured-output setting in SDK, use the SDK's strict function-calling option, buffer until complete object detected (delimiter or model-sent termination token), validate against function schema on the fly and request generation retry on schema mismatch.

SE notes: will demonstrate sample payloads that force deterministic function calls (explicit system instruction + allowed_functions list), show example of streaming with "end_of_object" sentinel and robust client-side buffer pattern.
Logs to collect: raw byte stream from socket, model delta events (timestamps, tokens), server-side truncation/close events, SDK flags used by client. Marked SUP-4521.
